items.quote: Frist: ein Monat nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: Bescheiddatum (letter's date) is Thu 26.03.2026. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a tax letter sent by ordinary post counts as delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 4th day after the day it is given to the post, i.e. Mon 30.03.2026 (this matches the letter's own note that it was 'zur Post gegeben' on 30.03.2026). Counting the one-month Einspruch period under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB / § 108 AO starts the day after Bekanntgabe and ends one month later on the day with the same number: Thu 30.04.2026. That day is a normal working day (no weekend/holiday shift needed).

warnings: The letter's Bescheiddatum (26.03.2026) and the note that it was 'zur Post gegeben' on 30.03.2026 are four days apart; both readings happen to yield the same Einspruch deadline (30.04.2026) once the statutory 4-day deemed-delivery rule is applied, but double-check the envelope's postmark if you want certainty.

The payee IBAN (DE92 5205 0000 0001 2003 40) is a valid, well-formed German IBAN for a Hessen-based Bankleitzahl (52050000); compare it with any earlier Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf correspondence before paying, as a valid IBAN does not by itself prove it is the tax office's genuine account.
